# List of acts of the 3rd session of the 4th Parliament of the United Kingdom

This is a complete list of acts of the 3rd session of the 3rd Parliament of the United Kingdom which had regnal year  49 Geo. 3. This session met from 19 January 1809 until 21 June 1809.
